method: Independent root review against exact authorized public inputs, actual prior contributions, supplied source-use permissions and own prior assessments. Mechanical/source calibration and fresh whole-response quality are separate.

jobs.notes: No invented prior proof point. Actual exclusive-attribution cap and own stable position preserved. Documentary focus stays in supplied-record scope.
Uses an explicit hypothetical rather than an invented actual proof point. Unknown receipt and assessment permission preserved; actual Crown submission expressly acknowledges the proof limit.
Preserves source cap, supplied-record scope and actual initial position; no invented prior point.

Actual prior jurors did use a non-observation framing, but the quoted phrase 'uncertainty, not observation of a handover' is compressed from longer contributions and is not verbatim. A correct paraphrase cannot be presented as a direct quotation. Exact-quote regression added and candidate superseded.
No invented prior point; source-purpose cap and current charge preserved. Quantitative/documentary preference wording remains a risk.

Critiques an inference from supplied presence observation without assigning it to another actor. Actual Crown proof-limit acknowledgment and unknown-receipt context retained; abbreviated beyond a doubt wording is a risk.
No fabricated quotation. All visible positions reach the same not-guilty conclusion; source-grounded convergence wording is broad and does not prove every prior paraphrase was accurate.
Explicit hypothetical challenge does not invent a real prior proof point. Exact limited-use instruction and uncertainty preserved; vote remains stable.

Current source inference critique preserves actual observed person, unknown receipt and no named giver in approved account. No formal assessment prohibition asserted. Inference-drawn wording remains ambiguous but attributes no named historical jury position.

Speech, rationale and stable-vote reason lose the knowledge qualifier with disclaimer about receipt and explicit receipt disclaimer. The source states non-knowledge about whether receipt occurred, not receipt denial. New nominal-disclaimer regression and correction added.

Receipt uncertainty is preserved, but speech invents a shared-record framing of established handover absence. Actual prior contributions state non-observation or missing proof. Shared-framing regression and agreement-permitting phase protocol added; this old candidate remains failed.

Protocol-updated replay permits agreement. Speech acknowledges actual unanimous visible positions without fabricated challenge; uncertainty, observed person and Crown proof-limit statement preserved. Rationale not-a-handover-observation refers to the supplied account rather than claiming explicit non-observation. Normalized optional belief/deliberation placeholders are not native substantive assertions.

Protocol-updated replay contains own assessment, no fabricated prior argument. Exclusive-attribution permission and supplied sole condition retained. Documentary/quantitative focus wording remains a profile risk; it does not add a mandatory legal corroboration rule.

Own generic inference critique names no historical actor or quotation. Exact exclusive-attribution use preserved, supplied-condition scope retained. Proof-point framing under the old mandatory challenge prompt remains ambiguous; documentary preference is not stated as a binding corroboration requirement.

Explicit some-might-apply hypothetical avoids inventing a prior argument; unknown receipt and permitted disputed assessment retained. Not-observation wording describes the supplied account, not a witness assertion of explicit non-observation.

Speech accurately notes that prior contributions found no exhibit establishes handover, but then invents exhibit-empty framing they did not assert. Rationale records only non-knowledge is an exhaustive summary that omits the actual observation of Ellis standing at the desk. Frozen source-check success does not establish whole-response quality. Old mandatory challenge request retained; production protocol-updated replays were separately reviewed.

Speech quotes the supplied source verbatim and no invented opposing argument remains. Rationale attributes to Mira presence at the desk, conflating the reporting witness and observed Ellis. Explicit observed-person attribution regression and deterministic guard added; this candidate remains failed.

Speech and rationale preserve observer Mira, observed Ellis, and receipt uncertainty; actual Crown proof-limit acknowledgment and own initial position retained. Optional normalized belief placeholders remain non-substantive.

Mixed unit accurately attributes the Crown concession but asserts E-001 records only uncertainty, omitting Ellis presence. Public-attribution exemption incorrectly bypassed source-summary checking. Mixed-source regression and fix added.

Speech preserves actual observed Ellis and unknown receipt; rationale attributes to Mira only presence at the desk, conflating reporting witness and observed person. Optional-only wording regression and exact-source summary instruction added.

Exact permitted-source uncertainty quotation, current instruction, stable own ballot and actual Crown proof-limit acknowledgment preserved. No invented prior argument, receipt denial, observed-person substitution or formal assessment prohibition. Sole-account-on-receipt wording is scoped to direct receipt statement; it should not be read as denying the distinct presence observation. Optional normalized placeholders are not native substantive facts.
